app.description: A web cursor presence demo, pure Contract since ENG-22524 (the Exact LLP 0281 stage-0 proof): one generated ephemeral collection, a Contract surface whose pointer stream rides a value channel with a rated publish, and two real browser clients seeing each other's latest cursor positions through generated bindings alone. The imperative DOM arm (LLP 0025) is deleted; its history lives in diary 0007.
app.name: Web cursor presence
